The sign-index formula follows from a sine phase with steps <π/2 and its scaling from discriminant differentiation. The exact-rational checker passes 120 supplementary assertions, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two-defect Hardy shift is the smallest family with independently variable first two weights and constant tail; complete-Pick status is not determined by concavity or expansivity. The full sharp parameter phase diagram contains a natural not expansive CNP interval; the exact first negative reciprocal coefficient and universal inverse-square-root delay explain the failure of any fixed finite-order coefficient test near a sharp boundary. These are motivated structural properties rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
